notes:
Resolved by OpenAlex keyword query, which returned three records for the same work: W4407359031 (arXiv, doi 10.48550/arxiv.2502.06438), W4416961180 (the published EMBC paper, doi 10.1109/embc58623.2025.11252697) and W7118277673 (an ETH Zurich Research Collection deposit). Crossref confirms the EMBC record as a proceedings-article in '2025 47th Annual International Conference of the IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Society (EMBC)', pages 1-7, published 2025-07-14, five authors in the order Tegon, Ingolfsson, Wang, Benini, Li. The publisher DOI is recorded because a published version of record exists; the arXiv abs page is recorded as source_url because that is the copy read. Tegon and Ingolfsson are marked co-first authors on the paper. LICENCE -- the arXiv abs-license block for 2502.06438 links http://arxiv.org/licenses/nonexclusive-distrib/1.0/, i.e. arXiv's default grant, which runs to arXiv and not to third parties, so the preprint-cc-arxiv token does not apply. The PDF itself additionally carries, verbatim: 'c2025 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted. Permission from IEEE must be obtained for all other uses, in any current or future media, including reprinting/republishing this material for advertising or promotional purposes, creating new collective works, for resale or redistribution to servers or lists, or reuse of any copyrighted component of this work in other works.' Both point the same way: deny by default, licence unknown, redistribution_ok false, no committed PDF. The arXiv v2 (17 Oct 2025) PDF is cached as source.local.pdf, which is gitignored and never committed, and source.md was generated from it; source.md is retained as internal research notes under fair use, on the same footing as a paywalled paper's extraction. VERSION -- v2 is the EMBC camera-ready, per the arXiv comments field ('Camera-ready version, EMBC 2025'), so it corresponds to the version of record. EXTRACTION -- pymupdf4llm, per _briefs/collection-practice.md; markitdown was not used. md_quality: rough because this is a two-column IEEE conference paper. What survived and what did not: running prose and Table I are clean; Tables II, III, IV and V extract as markdown tables with correct rows and values but with merged or shifted header cells, e.g. Table II's header renders as '|AUPR
AU|ROC|' and its AUPR and AUROC values are joined by '
' inside a single cell. Every number quoted on the card was read column by column against the PDF, and the TUAB row values were independently cross-checked against Table 1 of luna-2025/source.md, which reproduces the same baseline table (SPaRCNet 78.96, ST-Transformer 79.66, FEMBA-Huge 81.82 / 0.9005 / 0.8921) and agrees exactly. Figures 1, 2 and 3 render as picture text and are not usable; no card claim depends on them. All five equations are dropped from the extraction. Note also that the paper reports no sampling rate at all -- verified in Python rather than with grep, per the collection-practice warning about silent zeroes: the string 'Hz' occurs 0 times in source.md, and 'resampl' 0 times. Re-checked against the PDF's own text layer (pymupdf get_text over all seven pages), where 'Hz', 'resampl', 'sampling rate', 'bipolar' and 'referenc' all occur 0 times and 'montage' once, so this is an absence in the source rather than an extraction loss.
